description: This file defines an interface (IStorageManager) in the WPEFramework project, under the Exchange namespace. It declares virtual methods for managing storage associated with applications, such as creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing storage. The interface includes methods that are likely to be implemented by a class handling storage management in a larger system.

classes.name: IStorageManager
classes.description: An interface for managing application storage, including creation, retrieval, deletion, and clearing of storage resources. It inherits from Core::IUnknown and is meant to be implemented by classes handling storage logic.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for a specific application identified by appId, with a specified size in KB. Returns a storage path or an error reason.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the storage location, size, and used space details for a given appId, userId, and groupId.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes the storage associated with a specific appId.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage for a specific appId, also affecting device storage.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears storage for all apps except those explicitly exempted, based on a list of exemption app IDs.
